text:
Anika: Quick sync — big customer's asking to onboard the Nimbus-XL family. They want GA in 6 weeks and require a pin option + SLA. Thoughts?
Ravi: 6 weeks is tight. We need bench runs (latency + token cost) and memory profile first.
Maya: Customer called out 99th pct latency under 200ms for short prompts. That's going to be the blocker.
Jo: Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? That impacts rollout approach/tradeoffs.
Anika: They want Hosted first, but will move to Dedicated if we can offer pin + region isolation.
Sam: I can surface benchmark slices. Proposal: sample 5k prompts from their corpus, run 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 quant profiles.
Ravi: We'll need to test KV-cache effects for chat flows — 200ms is probably only feasible with aggressive caching + short seqs.
Maya: Also confirm model variant compatibility with our streaming + function-calls path. Some models drop tokens when quantized.
Anika: Customer also wants a soft-deprecation guarantee: 6 months notice + migration runbook. Can we commit?
Ravi: We can offer that if we include a compatibility shim (a pin fallback to previous major) during migration. Implementation is ~2 sprint work to wire rollout policy + fallback.
Jo: Prioritization: do we treat this as critical revenue motion (sales-assisted) or standard catalog onboarding?
Maya: Sales said it's high-value but not enterprise-locked; convert to dedicated later. I'd treat as high-priority but scoped.
Sam: For the bench plan: I can deliver initial microbench (latency p50/p95/p99, memory, tokens/sec) in 4 days. Full customer slice in 10.
Anika: Great. What are the launch gates? Suggestion: 1) Bench target met for p99 under 220ms on Hosted with recommended quant profile 2) No functional regressions in function-calls & streaming 3) Rollout policy + pin support enabled 4) Legal/Security signoff
Ravi: Add a canary rollout threshold: <=1% traffic & realtime fallback to a pinned fallback model if SLO breached. Also need a plan for autoscaling curves on Hosted side to avoid noisy neighbor spikes.
Maya: UX ask: expose a "pin to version" checkbox on Console + API param `pin_version=true`. Devex needs a small spec.
Jo: Resource ask: eng-runtime will need 1 eng for 3 sprints to implement rollout + fallback. Is PM okay to prioritize?
Anika: I can push for it this sprint, but we need to tradeoff other catalog work. If we approve, what's the risk?
Ravi: Risk = delayed other onboards (~2-3 weeks). Technical risk low but infra ops load increases during canary.
Sam: Also call out cost delta for customer if they choose full pin on Dedicated — we'll need to propose pricing.
Maya: Customer asked for an audit log of pin actions + who updated pins. Ops + security: doable?
Anika: Security flagged KMS integration for Private deploys, but for Hosted we'll keep logs in Console + export.
Jo: Proposed timeline: Day0 bench kickoff; Day4 microbench; Day10 full bench; Day12 devex + API spec; Day18 canary feature landed; Day25 canary runs; Day42 GA. That meets ~6-week ask if no blockers.
Ravi: Sounds realistic if we get eng headroom. I'll block 1 eng and a half-sprint of ops support during canary.
Maya: For deprecation/migration: propose a 6-month minimum deprecation window with automatic notify webhook + migration guide generated (diff in prompt sensitivities).
Anika: Customer ok with 6 months. Add a contractual SLA clause for pin support during that window.
Sam: I'll add bench artifacts to the model card: perf matrix, recommended quant, sample prompts, and migration notes.
Jo: Action items: Sam -> bench slices (4d). Ravi -> estimate eng work & PRD for rollout+fallback (end of week). Maya -> API+Console spec mockups (3 days). Anika -> customer comms + legal ask (2 days).
deploy-bot: Reminder: new thread created for bench artifacts: https://redwood.internal/bench/1689901234
Anika: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene Friday AM with bench results. :thumbsup:
